title: Primary voltage calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the RMS voltage of the primary coil from the given sinusoidal waveform.

title: Turns ratio determination
description: Essential: Correctly applies the transformer voltage ratio formula to find n1/n2 = 10/1.

title: Secondary resistance analysis
description: Important: Recognizes that closing the switch puts the two resistors in parallel, giving R_total = 5 Ω.

title: Power conservation application
description: Important: Correctly uses P1 = P2 and calculates secondary power from U2²/R_total to find 80 W.

title: Diode voltage calculation
description: Important: Correctly determines the RMS voltage after diode rectification using half-wave energy equivalence.

title: Peak vs RMS confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses peak primary voltage (282.8 V) instead of RMS (200 V) in transformer ratio calculation.

title: Series resistance error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly treats resistors as in series when switch is closed, giving R_total = 20 Ω.

title: Diode voltage oversight
description: Pitfall: Forgets to recalculate RMS voltage after diode rectification, using original 20 V instead of 10√2 V.
